description: Makes a one-page, print-ready PDF of a site screen for a Texas address or coordinate: screen score, a to-scale schematic map of the nearest substations, the substations and transmission lines within 5 miles with kV and owner, likely utility and load zone, and a screening disclaimer. Returns a link that opens the PDF and expires after 30 minutes; the PDF is a snapshot taken when you call the tool. Use when the user asks for a report, a PDF, a one-pager or something to send to a colleague, landowner or lender. Pro and Enterprise Lite accounts get the score, counts and grid facts; Enterprise accounts also get the strengths and risks behind the score, prices, gas, flood, jurisdiction and the parcel at the point. Free accounts get a description of what the report holds. Counts as one call.

address.description: Texas street address, e.g. '1201 Main St, Houston, TX'. Use this or lat/lng.

lat.description: Latitude (WGS84). Use with lng instead of address.

lng.description: Longitude (WGS84). Use with lat instead of address.

use.description: Intended use; shifts the flags and score weights. Default data_center.

name: report_pdf
title: One-page PDF site screen with map
